title: CPF Module Schema: Role Assignment Module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-roleassignment'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

condition.description: (Optional) Provide the condition that limits the resources that the role can be assigned to.

condition_version.description: (Optional) The version of the condition. Possible values are `1.0` or `2.0`.

delegated_managed_identity_resource_id.description: (Optional) Provide the delegated `Azure Resource Id` which contains a `Managed Identity`. This field is used in cross tenant scenario. The `principal_id` in this scenario must be the `object_id` of the `Managed Identity`

description.description: (Optional) A description for this Role Assignment.

name.description: (Optional) A unique UUID/GUID for this Role Assignment - one will be generated if not specified.

principal_id.description: (Required) Provide the `Object ID` of the `Principal(User, Group or Service Principal)` to assign the Role to. The Principal ID is also known as the `Object ID` (for `App registrations`, it is the **`Object ID` of the underlying Managed/Enterprise Application**).

role_definition_id.description: (Required*) Provide the "ID" of a built-in Role. See [list of built-in Roles](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/role-based-access-control/built-in-roles). Only one of `role_definition_name` or `role_definition_id` is required: if both are provided, it will return an error (valid input is: Id XOR Name).

role_definition_name.description: (Required*) Provide the "Name" of a built-in Role. See [list of built-in Roles](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/role-based-access-control/built-in-roles). Only one of `role_definition_name` or `role_definition_id` is required: if both are provided, it will return an error (valid input is: Id XOR Name).

scope.description: (Required) Provide the `Resource ID` of the `Resource` in which built-in Role needs to be assigned.

skip_service_principal_aad_check.description: (Optional) If the `principal_id` is a newly provisioned `Service Principal` set this value to `true` to skip the `Azure Active Directory` check: it may fail due to replication lag. This argument is only valid if the `principal_id` is of type `Service Principal`.

principal_id.description: The object ID of the role assigned

scope.description: List the scope on which rbac is applied

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Roleassignment' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
